statement: You are given an integer array nums. Sort it into non-decreasing order with merge sort.

Split the range in half at its midpoint and sort each half recursively; a range of one element is already sorted. Then merge the two sorted halves with two pointers, repeatedly taking the smaller front element (the left one on a tie).

examples.explanation: [5, 2, 8] is split and merged into [2, 5, 8], and [1, 9] stays [1, 9]. The final merge interleaves them.
A reversed input sorts the same way: the halves are sorted, then merged back together.
